title: The Poxxe Region

body:
Dive Into a New Adventure - Cobblemon Awaits! ⚡

Explore a fully modded 1.21.1 Minecraft server where the world of Pokémon comes alive! Catch, train, and battle alongside friends in a vibrant, ever-evolving world packed with custom features, unique biomes, and exciting challenges.

🔥 Build your dream team
🌍 Explore a unique world with hand-built gyms
⚔️ Battle trainers & rise to the top

Whether you're a casual explorer or a competitive trainer, your journey starts here.

Join now; your legend begins today. 🎮✨

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

More information regarding the custom "Poxxe Region" (gym system/champion rankings) is available in the discord server!
